# Token contrast matrix

Generated by `node scripts/tokens/generate.mjs`; values are never changed to repair a failing diagnostic pair.

Every semantic/component colour (including chart danger, Aurora cards, loader-local colours and states) is checked against every catalogued surface/fill/state ground in both themes. Each row tests normal text at 4.5:1 and large text, icon, essential UI boundary, focus and state indicators at 3:1. These exhaustive diagnostics include forbidden uses: a PASS is not permission to ignore a token’s purpose. Only the permitted-pair contract is asserted as required by the validator.

Ratios use sRGB linearisation and unrounded comparisons. Display rounds to 4 decimals; 2.9999 is a FAIL. Large text means at least 24 CSS px, or 18.667 CSS px bold. Disabled controls and decorative dividers can be exempt; their ratios remain visible. Text-labelled buttons do not automatically need a contrasting perimeter. Focus uses a 2px outline and 2px offset on neutral surroundings; check adjacency, clipping, area and visibility in the actual UI. Token contrast alone cannot certify WCAG conformance.

Standards: [WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/), [non-text contrast](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast/), [focus appearance (AAA)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-appearance/).

> **Current rule (v2.1.0, 2026-11-13; DSA-014):** Keep legacy `outline`, `accent`, `accent-hover`, `accent-active`, `line` and `danger-line` values. For essential neutral control boundaries use `semantic.color.boundary-strong` (light muted / dark outline). For thin selected marks use `semantic.color.state-indicator` (accent-ink); tenant marks use brand-boundary. This supersedes treating outline as safe on every hover ground or accent fills as safe thin marks. Matrix replacements below are conditional on the displayed ground.

## Scrim composites

Scrim pigment is not text. These are the resultant grounds over neutral surfaces at each shipped scrim opacity. Dialog content remains on opaque panel; do not render text directly on a backdrop. Ratios below test ink and focus against the composited ground for diagnostics.

| Theme | Ground | Opacity | Composited sRGB | Ink ratio | Focus ratio |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| light | bg | 0.3 | 184.500 184.000 175.000 | 7.3945 | 3.0862 |
| light | bg | 0.35 | 172.750 174.000 165.500 | 6.5844 | 2.7481 |
| light | bg | 0.4 | 161.000 164.000 156.000 | 5.8349 | 2.4353 |
